name: Hangzhou Xili Intelligent Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Hangzhou Xili Intelligent Technology Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese firm specializing in the research, development, manufacturing, and provision of advanced energy and utility measurement devices. Its comprehensive product line includes conventional energy and water meters, sophisticated terminals for collecting energy consumption data, specialized enclosures for meters, cable distribution boxes, and electric vehicle charging stations. This entity was formerly recognized as Hangzhou Xili Watthour Meter Manufacture Co. Ltd. Established in 1968, the company is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
